concepts.gloss_en: The rock (Ps. 114 'who turns the rock into a pool of water') — i.e. the heart of stone/hard-heartedness that charity softens into water

reason_for_human: Round-1 read הצור as a divine epithet ('the Rock' = God), but the full paragraph shows the opposite: the text explicitly equates הַצּוּר with צוּר לְבָבִי and with לֵב אֶבֶן (the stony heart of the hard-hearted, far from charity) that gets 'turned into a pool of water' / soft heart. So the referent is the rock-as-heart, not God. The concept stays a single member; only the gloss/identity is corrected.
